name: Aegis electronics J2 connector seating inspection

checks.name: J2 connector seating
checks.faultTitle: J2 connector is not fully seated
checks.faultDescription: The J2 plug is visibly elevated and offset from the board-mounted header compared with the seated reference.
checks.correctiveAction: Keep power off. Align J2 squarely over the header and press straight down until the plug is fully seated, then capture a new frame.
checks.verificationMethod: Capture a newer full-board frame and confirm the J2 plug body is flush and aligned with the header outline.
